what: a repository whose tests need an npm dependency (fixtures/dep-lib, dependency ms@2.1.3), on staging (Artifacts + Containers). scripts/e2e-deps.mjs.
design: The test container keeps internet disabled; the only reachable name is registry.npm.internal, routed by Container.interceptOutboundHttp to the RegistryProxy Worker entrypoint, which forwards GET/HEAD to registry.npmjs.org and refuses everything else.

Install commands come from the protected .gitflare/gates.json and run as root with npm_config_ignore_scripts=true and a root-only, content-addressed npm cache (npm checks it against the lockfile integrity hashes).
Test commands run as the unprivileged node user (su-exec): node_modules and the npm cache are out of reach, /tmp and the test HOME are wiped before every run.

liveMutation.change: test commands run as root instead of the node user
liveMutation.observed: the sandbox probe wrote node_modules/ms/index.js, its assertion failed, and the tampered dependency also broke test/seconds.test.mjs in the same run (ReferenceError: tampered is not defined); DP3 was rejected. With the fix restored the probe passes.
